stable.notes: Jedi Miles Windu ships as the default character: the pet has real art on a fresh install, with no sprite pack to add. Character size is its own 100-300% dial, so the figure can grow while the card keeps its size, and the card now measures the actual art instead of assuming a wide cinematic frame. Story strips drop the scenes their subject is absent from, frames cut by a boundary no longer leave a flash in the corner, cinematic scenes cross-dissolve, and three sessions no longer animate the same as five. A Cursor pet click opens that session's Agents tab. Pet controls read in dark mode. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
